name: University of Tasmania
summary: Tasmania's university, with marine and Antarctic science taught in Hobart; the IB Diploma counts as Year 12 and 24 points meets most entry minimums.

ib.text: UTAS recognises the IB Diploma as equivalent to Australian Year 12; an overall score of 24 meets the minimum for most undergraduate programs and some programs ask more. Results can be released by the IB directly.

noDeadline: No closing date for most courses; apply 5 months before semester

programmes.name: Bachelor of Marine and Antarctic Science
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Marine and Antarctic Science
programmes.about: Three years in Hobart through the Institute for Marine and Antarctic Studies, building an understanding of marine environments across natural and social sciences, with units such as Ecology and Biology of Animals.
programmes.ib: UTAS minimum for most undergraduate programs is an IB score of 24; majors can add subject prerequisites, so check the entry requirements tab.
programmes.selectionNote: Eligibility needs the IB Diploma with an overall score of 24 or more, plus the prerequisites of your major.

flagshipSource.title: Marine and Antarctic Science: taught through IMAS in Hobart, a large marine and Antarctic research group

notes: There is no closing date for most courses; UTAS recommends overseas students apply at least five months before semester starts, because a student visa takes time.
Your school's IB coordinator should give the IB permission to release your results to UTAS directly.
Entry minimums are listed by country on one table, and some programs set a higher requirement.
